biotools.summary: HerbUA (Collectors of Ukrainian Herbaria) is an open-source web data portal for online publication of herbarium collector-centric data, operated by the Herbarium of the State Museum of the Natural History NAS of Ukraine (LWS) to support collaborative digitization of small Ukrainian herbaria.
